# Tagwerk

> Self-hosted family calendar for a wall-mounted tablet and the family's
> phones: calendar, tasks with stars, shopping lists, meal plan, recipes,
> photo frame. Laravel 13 + Filament 5 + Nuxt 4, PostgreSQL. Several
> households on one server, strictly separated. Source-available under
> PolyForm Shield 1.0.0; the plugin API is MIT.

Working on Tagwerk itself, read AGENTS.md first: it holds the conventions
and the pitfalls. Writing a plugin, read docs/plugins.md and depend on
`tagwerk/plugin-api` only — never on classes under `App\`.

## Plugins

- [Writing a Tagwerk plugin](https://github.com/pointia/tagwerk/blob/master/docs/plugins.md): the guide — package, offers, tiles, providers, areas, language packs, design packs, testing, stability
- [tagwerk/plugin-api](https://github.com/pointia/tagwerk/tree/master/apps/platform/packages/plugin-api): contracts, data objects, `Testing\PluginAssertions`
- [Building a frontend](https://github.com/pointia/tagwerk/blob/master/docs/frontends.md): your own interface in place of the app — client, contract, shipping
- [Frontend template](https://github.com/pointia/tagwerk/tree/master/apps/platform/templates/frontend): Vite + TypeScript on @tagwerk/client
- [API contract](https://github.com/pointia/tagwerk/blob/master/apps/platform/routes/api-contract.txt): the routes frontends may rely on
- [Plugin template](https://github.com/pointia/tagwerk/tree/master/apps/platform/templates/plugin): a widget plugin with tests, CI and AGENTS.md
- [Example plugin](https://github.com/pointia/tagwerk/tree/master/apps/platform/plugins/example-area): an area and a tile with settings and buttons
